summary: Retrieve: Retrieve Returns the Full Booking Without a Valid x-api-key or Client-Id (also: TC-AUTH-SEC-06, TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-01, TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-02)
expected_value: { "Status": 401 }  (same as every other endpoint)
impact: Unauthenticated read access to passenger PII. The other endpoints show that authentication is implemented, so Retrieve was most likely left outside the filter. Also shows up as a failure in TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-01/02.
evidence: Retrieve answers HTTP 200 with the complete booking when the x-api-key header is invalid or missing and when Client-Id is invalid or missing. Every other V2 endpoint probed (Search, FareConfirm, GetOfferBundles, GetAncillary, SeatMap, FareConfirmAfterHold, Book, Hold, BookAfterHold, Void) returns 401.

summary: Retrieve: A Booking Created Under USA Is Readable Under credentialsSelector EGY (also: TC-VOIDCAP-SEC-03)
expected_value: 4xx — the booking belongs to another credentials selector
impact: Cross-tenant data exposure for any supplier with more than one active selector. The same behaviour was already seen on SeatMap in earlier rounds for other suppliers.
evidence: A booking created with credentialsSelector USA is returned by Retrieve when the same pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken is sent with credentialsSelector EGY (an active AirArabiaPlus selector). UAE and KSA are rejected only because they are not configured for this supplier.

summary: BookAfterHold: BookAfterHold Tickets a Hold After holdExpirationDate Has Passed (also: TC-BOOKAFTERHOLD-NEG-01, TC-HOLD-BND-01)
expected_value: 4xx / 409 — the hold has expired
impact: Customers or agents can ticket holds that the airline has already released; revenue and inventory integrity depend on the supplier happening to honour it. Reproduced three times (FLOW-V2-28-NEG, TC-BOOKAFTERHOLD-NEG-01, TC-HOLD-BND-01).
evidence: Three separate holds were left until after their holdExpirationDate (the supplier window is about 75 minutes) and BookAfterHold was called. Each call returned HTTP 200 and issued tickets; Retrieve then showed the booking as Booked.

summary: Book: A Second Book on the Same Offer Creates a Second PNR (also: no other test case)
expected_value: second call rejected (409) or idempotent (same pnr "6Y6KFZ")
impact: Duplicate PNRs and tickets, refund/void burden (Void is not supported for this supplier).
evidence: Book was sent twice with the identical ResponseId and selectedOfferId. The first call returned PNR 6Y6KFZ; the second returned a different PNR (63K720) instead of being refused or returning the first booking.

summary: Book: ResponseId Is Ignored: Missing, Unknown or Mismatched Values Are Accepted (also: FLOW-V2-26-NEG, TC-FARECONFIRM-NEG-01, TC-FARECONFIRM-VAL-01, TC-BOOK-NEG-12, TC-SEATMAP-NEG-04, TC-PAXNAME-NEG-15, TC-VERSIONDIFF-NEG-01)
expected_value: 400/409 — ResponseId does not belong to selectedOfferId
impact: Clients cannot rely on validation to catch id-chaining mistakes; combined with BUG-04/BUG-06 the booking context is only loosely bound.
evidence: The offer is resolved from selectedOfferId alone; ResponseId is not validated. Observed: Book with the ResponseId of chain A and the selectedOfferId of chain B created a booking; Hold with an unknown ResponseId created a hold; FareConfirm without ResponseId returned 200; FareConfirm accepted the V1 name searchResponseId; Book without ResponseId created a booking; AddPassenger with an all-zero ResponseId returned 200; SeatMap without ResponseId returned a seat map.

summary: BookAfterHold: bookingToken Is Not Checked Against pnr (Retrieve, FareConfirmAfterHold, BookAfterHold) (also: no other test case)
expected_value: 4xx — the bookingToken does not belong to the pnr
impact: Weakens booking ownership; with BUG-01 any PNR holder can read it unauthenticated and ticket it with an arbitrary token.
evidence: With two holds A and B, a request carrying the pnr of A and the bookingToken of B is accepted by Retrieve, FareConfirmAfterHold and BookAfterHold; the pnr decides which booking is acted on and the token is ignored (BookAfterHold ticketed hold A).

summary: Book: A Seat cellId Issued for Another Offer Is Accepted at Book (also: no other test case)
expected_value: 4xx — the seat token does not belong to this offer
impact: Seat and seat-fee integrity depend on the supplier accepting or rejecting a foreign token.
evidence: Seat tokens (cellId) are bound to the offer that produced them, yet Book accepted the cellId taken from offer A when booking offer B and created a booking.

summary: Search: No Air Arabia Egypt (E5) Offers Are Returned for the Reference Routes (also: TC-ROUTE-E5-HBE-BGY)
expected_value: { "offers": [ { "offerJourneys": [ "E5…" ], ... } ] }
impact: E5 flows (base, bundle, ancillary, seat map) could not be executed: TC-CARRIER-E5-BASE/BUNDLE/ANCILLARY/SEATMAP are BLOCKED. Root cause not visible from the API: no E5 configuration for credentialsSelector USA, or a missing carrier mapping — needs the integration team to confirm.
evidence: Search for CAI-MCT and HBE-BGY returned HTTP 200 with offers=[] on every one of 16 CAI-MCT and 16 HBE-BGY calls (dates from 2026-11-20 to 2027-01-15, 1 adult and 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant), each answered in about 0.5 s, plus 17 additional E5-style routes. No E5 flight appeared in any aggregated answer.

summary: Search: Air Arabia Maroc (3O) Search Is Unreliable: Empty 200 After 15 Seconds, Offers Only Intermittently (also: TC-ROUTE-3O-CMN-SAW)
expected_value: offers[] for 3O flights, or an explicit error (e.g. 409 supplier timeout) when the supplier does not answer
impact: 3O flows could not be executed reliably (TC-CARRIER-3O-* BLOCKED); a client cannot retry intelligently because an empty 200 looks like a valid answer.
evidence: SAW-CMN never returned an offer (28 calls, 26 of them answered empty after about 15 s). CMN-SAW returned a 3O offer in only 3 of 79 calls (2026-12-08 once, 2026-12-12 twice, all within one short window early in the run); the other calls returned HTTP 200 with offers=[] and no error, almost all after about 15 s. The constant 15 s suggests a supplier timeout that is swallowed into an empty successful answer.

summary: Book: paxTotalAncillaryAmount Differs Between Book/FareCheck and Retrieve for the Same Booking (also: RT-BUN-01)
expected_value: the same ancillary amount in every response; paxTotalAmount = base + tax + ancillary + bundle
impact: Invoices and receipts built from the breakdown disagree with the total; price-reconciliation checks fail (OW-BUN-02, RT-BUN-01).
evidence: For a bundle booking with a child, FareCheck and Book report paxTotalAncillaryAmount 399.52 per passenger (totalAncillariesAmount 799.04) while Retrieve reports 297.44 (594.88) for the same booking. The grand total (12529.66) is identical in all three, and paxTotalAmount only adds up with the Retrieve figure (1352 + 3376.62 + 297.44 + 811.2 = 5837.26).

summary: FareConfirm: Offer Totals Differ From the Per-Passenger Sums by a Few Hundredths (also: no other test case)
expected_value: "totalTaxAmount": 19692.48, "totalAmount": 32969.12
impact: Strict reconciliation fails for multi-passenger-type offers (FLOW-V2-31 fails; other flows pass only because they use a 0.05 tolerance).
evidence: For a 1 ADT + 1 CHD + 1 INF offer, priceDetails.totalTaxAmount is 19692.42 while the sum of the per-passenger taxes x counts and of priceDetails.taxesAndFees is 19692.48; totalAmount is 32969.06 vs 32969.12 (delta 0.06). The same 0.06 appears in Book and Retrieve.

summary: SeatMap: Seat Price Shown in the Seat Map Is Lower Than the Amount Charged (About 5% Tax Added at Book) (also: no other test case)
expected_value: seat map totalPrice includes the tax that Book adds, or the booking delta equals the seat total
impact: Price shown and price charged differ for every seat purchase.
evidence: The seat map shows taxesPrice 0 and totalPrice 338 for the chosen seats, but the booking total rises by 354.77 compared with the FareConfirm total (338 + 16.77, roughly 5% extra tax).

summary: SeatMap: Occupied Seats Carry Per-Passenger Price Details (also: TC-SEATMAP-BIZ-03)
expected_value: "seatPriceDetailsByPassenger": null for Occupied/Blocked cells
impact: Consumers must filter on cellAvailability; 154 price entries refer to seats outside the passengers' allow-lists.
evidence: In a seat map with 42 Occupied cells every Occupied cell still carries seatPriceDetailsByPassenger for each passenger (e.g. seat 1A, 1B), although the passengers' allow-lists do not contain these seats.

summary: Search: Search Accepts 10 Passengers Although the Maximum Is 9 (also: no other test case)
expected_value: 400 — a total above 9 passengers is rejected
impact: Over-limit parties fail later (or are mis-sold) instead of at Search.
evidence: Search for 8 ADT + 1 CHD + 1 INF (10 passengers) returns HTTP 200 with a priced offer, exactly like the 9-passenger baseline on the same date.

summary: Search: Two Different Error Envelopes and Unclassified 409 Z9999 Errors for Validation and Transient Failures (also: TC-SEARCH-NEG-03)
expected_value: one envelope, one error-code scheme, and a 400 validation error for lowercase codes
impact: Error handling cannot be generic; retryable (transient) and non-retryable (validation) failures look the same.
evidence: Search/SeatMap model-binding errors return a camelCase body {status, transactionId, errorCode "1001", errorMessage, context[{name,value}], originalSupplierRequest, originalSupplierResponse}; FareConfirm, Book, AddPassenger business validation returns PascalCase {Status, TransactionId, ErrorCode "NDC-INT-TEC-A0001", ErrorMessage, Context[{Name,Value}]}. Search with lowercase airport codes returns 409 "NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999" whose ErrorMessage equals the code (the text is only in Context), and a trans

summary: SeatMap: A Malformed selectedOfferId Returns HTTP 500 ServerError Instead of a 4xx (also: no other test case)
expected_value: { "Status": 400/409, "ErrorCode": "...", "Context": [ "The selected offer is invalid, expired, or could not be found." ] }
impact: Unhandled exception path on invalid ids.
evidence: SeatMap with a well-formed but unknown ResponseId and selectedOfferId "not-a-real-offer" returns 500 {"ErrorCode":"ServerError","ErrorMessage":"Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference."} with an empty Context. A FareConfirm with selectedOfferId "x" showed the same during exploration.

summary: AddPassenger: Names With a Hyphen, Apostrophe or Accented Letter Are Rejected ("alphabetic characters only") (also: TC-PAXNAME-VAL-04)
expected_value: 200 — real surnames with hyphens/apostrophes are accepted (or normalised)
impact: Customers with such names (Smith-Jones, O’Brien, José, Müller) must alter them, risking a document mismatch at the airport.
evidence: AddPassenger rejects last names such as SMITH-JJJJ… and O'CONNOR-O'BRIEN-O'DONNELL with 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 "Passenger name must contain alphabetic characters only." Accented names (José, Müller), Arabic letters, digits, a "/" or "(" in a name, control characters and leading/trailing spaces are rejected with the same message (TC-PAXNAME-VAL-06…16); an embedded space is accepted.

summary: AddPassenger: ParentPaxRefId Is Ignored: The Infant Is Attached to the First Adult (also: no other test case)
expected_value: "passengerRefId": "I3/A2"
impact: Wrong adult may be responsible for the infant; name-change or check-in issues.
evidence: With two adults and an infant declared under Pax2 (the second adult), the booking attaches the infant to the first adult: the fare breakdown reference is I3/A1.

summary: Void: OperationNotSupported Says "AirArabiaPlus does not exists" Although the Supplier Exists (also: no other test case)
expected_value: "Value": "AirArabiaPlus does not support Void"
impact: Support teams look for a missing supplier configuration instead of recognising a capability limit.
evidence: Void, CancelAfterHold, Upselling, FareRules, SeatAfterHold, ReleasePnr and refund quota all answer 409 OperationNotSupported with Context "AirArabiaPlus does not exists" (wrong meaning and wrong grammar).

summary: FareConfirmAfterHold: voidCapability Returned as Null in FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) Response (also: TC-VOIDCAP-BIZ-02, TC-VOIDCAP-VAL-12)
expected_value: "voidCapability": "VoidNotAllowed"
impact: The flag cannot be used from the re-price step; mapping coverage has an empty cell.
evidence: The key is present but null in all 33 FareConfirmAfterHold responses of this run, while Hold, BookAfterHold, Book and Retrieve return "VoidNotAllowed" for the same booking.

summary: Book: The Commercial Blacklist for Air Arabia (G9) Does Not Block Book Through AirArabiaPlus (also: no other test case)
expected_value: Book rejected at the business layer for a blacklisted airline
impact: If the gate must cover One-API, sales of a blacklisted carrier are possible in production.
evidence: SPEC §4.3 lists Air Arabia G9/E5/3L/3O as outright blacklisted for booking-affecting actions. Through the new AirArabiaPlus supplier, Book (and Hold, BookAfterHold) succeed and issue tickets on staging.

summary: FareCheck: Services Offered by GetAncillary/SeatMap Are Rejected as "Not Available" at FareCheck, Hold or Book (Bundle Flows Often Fail on the First Bundle Code) (also: FLOW-V2-33, FLOW-V2-46)
expected_value: only sellable meals, baggage and seats are returned, and a rejected selection carries a classified error code
impact: Ancillary and bundle conversion loss; the generic Z9999 code hides why.
evidence: 19 FareCheck/Hold/Book/GetAncillary calls in this run failed with 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 for items that GetAncillary or SeatMap had just offered: "Selected Meals are not available at the moment [CHIDIL / LKRRC]", "Selected Baggages are not available [30 Kg Total in 2 Piece Discounted]", "No seat at this location", "Invalid Bundled Service Selected". 19 of the 32 bundle test cases needed a second or third bundle code before they could be completed; bundle 66580 usually fails at GetAncillary (no me

summary: AddPassenger: Validation Errors Disclose Internal .NET Type Names and JSON Paths (also: TC-PAXNAME-NEG-13)
expected_value: a message that names the field only (e.g. "passengersList.Pax1.name.first must be a string")
impact: Helps an attacker map the internal model; noisy for API consumers.
evidence: Model-binding errors return messages such as "The addPaxRequestDto field is required." and "The JSON value could not be converted to System.Nullable`1[NDC.Integrations.Application.Dtos.Api.TravelDocType]. Path: $.passengersList.Pax1…"; SeatMap returns "…converted to System.Guid. Path: $.ResponseId".

summary: GetAncillary: passengersAncillariesAvailabilty Key Is Misspelled in the GetAncillary Response (also: no other test case)
expected_value: "passengersAncillariesAvailability"
impact: Consumers who follow the correct spelling get no availability data.
evidence: The response key is "passengersAncillariesAvailabilty" (missing "i"); the correctly spelled key does not exist, so clients must code to the typo.
